E3501

`fn build` must take one `BuildContext` and return `BuildPlan`.

What

`fn build` must take one `BuildContext` and return `BuildPlan`.

Why

Build authority and graph handoff are one typed contract. A different signature cannot be selected by `jet build` or modeled by the LSP.

Fix

Write `fn build(b: BuildContext) BuildPlan`.
